site_name: Triangle Development Site Situated Adjacent To Paddington Station
description: Amendments to planning permission dated 2nd April 2015 (RN:12/07668/FULL) for Development of an office building comprising canal-side reception with 21 storeys of offices measuring 34,184m2 (GIA) and including 132m2 of either Class A1/A2/A3 use at canal-side and first floor level, alongside pedestrian linkages to Paddington Station and Bishop's Bridge Road, in conjunction with landscaping and other associated works. Namely, rationalisation of the southern structural transfer expression, rationalisation of the canal side structural transfer expression to match the structural grid, centralisation of the canal side office reception doors, reconfiguration of the east and central core, including: addition of a dedicated fire-fighting lift, addition of a combined passenger/evacuation lift and a passenger/goods lift that now serve the basement levels, and enlargement and relocation of the accessible WC from the eastern to the central core; external alterations to the western lift shaft façade, reducing the extent of glazing; the material treatment of the stair and lift cores has also been upgraded from aluminium cladding to concrete; 500mm extension of the north office façade, partially offsetting the internal area loss resulting  from the increased central core footprint described above; replacement of the brie soleil (fins) with a deeply expressed mullion system as a result of the proposed high-performance CCF system; the external terraces have been reconfigured to optimise balcony size, shape, and proportion (the full height glazing has been retained) Internal layout reconfiguration and adjustment of the Building Maintenance Unit (BMU) layout at roof level.
